event_summary: A thin rod near a black circular object moves into the right-side row of upright blocks, after which several right-side blocks topple while the duck and left-side blocks remain upright.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a yellow rubber duck centered on a wooden tabletop, flanked by upright black and light-colored rectangular blocks. A black circular object sits behind the right-side blocks, with a thin tan rod near it. The rod changes angle and extends toward the rightmost block in the right-side row. The rightmost black block then tilts, and several neighboring right-side blocks fall into slanted or lying positions. The left-side blocks and the duck remain visibly unchanged and upright through the end.

reasons: The duck, both rows of upright rectangular blocks, and the black circular object are visible before the toppling begins.
